still UX Research
UX Research Report · 2025

Designing for Stillness
in a Noisy World

"An in-depth research study on Still — a mobile journaling and observation app that trains users to see the world with an artist’s eye."

PlatformMobile (iOS / Android)
FrameworkReact + TypeScript
Design PhaseConcept → Hi-Fi Prototype
Research TypeFormative · Evaluative
01 — Overview

What is Still?

A mobile journaling application that bridges the gap between mindful observation and creative expression — helping users cultivate an artist’s attentiveness to everyday life.

“notice the world, moment by moment”

— Still App Tagline

Still is built around a Renaissance-inspired philosophy: that the practice of deep observation — noticing light, texture, shadow, and human gesture — is itself a form of artistry. The app removes social-media pressure and replaces it with a gentle invitation to simply notice and record.

The product is deliberately narrow in scope: four screens, one core loop, and a visual language drawn from coastal calm and literary craft. This restraint is not a limitation — it is the entire design statement.

4Core screens
3Font families, intentionally paired
15+Curated sample observations
2Visibility modes per entry
9sOnboarding animation duration

Notice

The core loop begins with noticing — users are prompted to pay attention to what surrounds them before putting a single word down.

Record

A distraction-free, texture-rich writing canvas gives every observation its own contemplative space, free from algorithmic noise.

Share (optionally)

Users choose their privacy on a per-entry basis — a rare design decision that puts autonomy first, always.

02 — Users

Who is Still designed for?

Research identified three distinct but overlapping user archetypes who share a common desire: to feel more present and creative in everyday life.

EM

The Quiet Creative

Artist / designer / writer · 22–35

Wants a private creative outlet that doesn’t demand an audience. Values beautiful, distraction-free interfaces and seeks a tool that matches her aesthetic sensibility.

JC

The Mindful Observer

Professional or student · 25–40

Uses journaling as a mindfulness practice. Attracted by the philosophy of slowing down. Wants a place to store memory fragments without the pressure of long-form writing.

LV

The Community Seeker

Social-media-fatigue user · 20–32

Craves authentic connection without vanity metrics. Loves sharing observations on the Discover feed and reading how others see the world — with zero algorithmic pressure.

User Needs Identified

Low-friction writing Privacy by default Aesthetic calm Optional sharing No performance metrics Tactile, warm interface Daily writing prompts Personal stats without judgment Image support Editable identity

04 — User Experience

A journey of careful moments

Every screen in Still is designed to feel like a pause — an invitation rather than a demand. The user journey is intentionally unhurried.

1

Splash Screen — Setting the tone

An animated sandy beach scene with real hand-illustrated seashell and starfish assets, a multi-phase wave animation, and the app wordmark in Italianno script. The 9-second animation is a deliberate deceleration — a threshold ritual that transitions the user into a slower, more attentive mode.

2

Write View — The primary action

Users land on the Write screen, not a feed. This prioritises creation over consumption from the very first moment. The sand-texture canvas overlaid with a warm wash and Lora typeface make writing feel warm and intentional. A visibility toggle and image upload live just beneath the canvas, kept simple and deliberate.

3

Visibility Toggle — Consent before publish

Before saving, users consciously choose private or public. The switch is presented as a full Card component — not a footnote checkbox — ensuring the privacy decision is always considered, never accidental. Default is private.

4

Chronicle — Personal archive

The user’s own entries live in “yours” — a personal journal that excludes all other voices. Users can toggle entry visibility, read back their history, or delete, all without leaving their private space. Entry cards use a photo header when an image is attached, giving each observation its own visual identity.

5

Discover — Community without metrics

A curated feed of public observations from all users. Sections are organised by recency and prompt-inspiration — not by engagement score. A community stats card shows only how many observations exist, never who is most popular. Every observation is treated as equally worth reading.

6

Profile — Reflection, not performance

Stats are present but framed gently (“ur stats, if u care”). The profile is fully editable — name, tagline, avatar — and closes with an affirmational quote rather than a follower count. The data exists to help users reflect on their practice, not compare themselves to others.

05 — Design System

Visual language — warmth, craft, and restraint

The design system is built around a single metaphor: a quiet morning at the beach, where the light is golden and time moves slowly. Every visual decision reinforces this feeling.

An intentionally narrow palette of eight values — three neutrals, two primaries, one accent, and two text values — that prevents visual fatigue during extended journaling sessions.

Typography

Three Voices, One Harmony

Italianno (script) — Used exclusively for the wordmark and key editorial moments. Lends the brand an artisan, handcrafted quality that instantly differentiates Still from productivity tools.

Playfair Display (display serif) — Headlines, section titles, user names, and navigation labels. Authoritative yet literary; evokes book design and long-form print editorial.

Lora / Crimson Text (reading serifs) — Body text and the writing canvas itself. Chosen for their exceptional legibility at small sizes and the warmth they lend to prose. Both are optimised for extended reading, which is critical for a journaling interface.

Motion Design

Animation with Meaning

Framer Motion powers the bottom navigation’s shared layout animation — the active indicator glides between tabs using spring physics (stiffness 300, damping 30), creating a smooth, physical feel that plain CSS cannot replicate.

The splash screen uses a multi-phase wave animation: a 6-second ambient shoreline cycle followed by a 3.6-second cubic-bezier wash transition. Tap interactions use a whileTap spring scale of 0.9 for immediate haptic-like feedback on every navigation press.

Texture & Atmosphere

Tangible Surfaces

The Write View uses a photographic sand-texture overlay on the writing card, softened with a 60% opacity wash, creating a sense of physical material beneath the user’s words — as though writing on a beach journal or aged parchment.

The body background uses background-attachment: fixed, so the gradient stays still as the user scrolls. This reinforces the app’s name and its core promise of presence.

Mobile-First Layout

Constraint as a Feature

The entire layout is constrained to a 480px maximum width, matching mobile form factors precisely. Navigation is bottom-anchored with safe-area padding for notched devices. The sticky top header and fixed bottom nav create a predictable structure operable one-handed.

The four-item tab bar follows mobile best practices: icon plus text label, generous 44px tap targets, spring-animated active state, and clear visual feedback on every interaction.

06 — Design Decisions & Insights

What makes Still distinctively well-designed

Through close analysis of the component architecture, visual system, and interaction design, several standout decisions emerge that demonstrate mature UX thinking.

Privacy First, Always

The default state on the Write View is private. Users must consciously opt in to sharing. This is the inverse of most social platforms — and exactly right for a tool where psychological safety is the foundation of honest writing.

Creation Before Consumption

Landing users on the Write screen — not the Discover feed — is a bold, principled choice. It communicates that Still’s core value is your own voice, not other people’s content. Every session begins with a creative invitation.

Tone-Consistent Microcopy

Error messages (“you gotta write something first bestie”) and UI labels (“got a pic? add it”) are written in the same warm, casual register as the app’s philosophy — breaking the clinical sterility of standard validation messages.

No Vanity Metrics on Discover

The community feed shows no like counts, no follower numbers, no trending scores. Content is ordered by recency and type only. This removes comparison anxiety and positions every observer as equally valued.

Meaningful Onboarding Pacing

The 9-second animated splash is a studied deceleration — intentionally longer than the industry-standard 2–3 seconds. It functions as a threshold ritual, preparing users for a slower, more attentive mode of engagement.

Editable Identity, Not Fixed Profile

The profile defaults to “ur space” and “just vibing and noticing things” — signalling that identity here is fluid and playful, not a public-facing brand to be carefully managed. Every field is editable inline.

“The purpose of art is washing the dust of daily life off our souls.”

— Inspiration quote within the Still landing page

Design Principles Embodied

Clarity through restraint

A deliberately limited colour palette (8 values), a constrained layout (480px max-width), and a single-column content structure prevent cognitive overload and keep focus on the written word.

Emotional resonance over feature density

Still has four screens. That’s it. The scope constraint is the feature — it signals that depth of experience matters more than breadth of functionality.

Micro-interactions as care

The spring-physics tab animation, the wave-transition splash, and the whileTap haptic response are not decorative. They communicate that the interface was crafted with genuine attention — mirroring the attentiveness the app asks of its users.

Typography as philosophy

Choosing three distinct literary typefaces rather than a single system font communicates — without a single word — that this is a place where language and aesthetics matter deeply.

Autonomy at every touchpoint

From the per-entry privacy toggle to the optional image upload to the fully editable profile, every major action in Still gives the user a choice. The app never makes decisions on the user’s behalf.

Component architecture strength

Each view is independently encapsulated and props-driven. The shared Entry interface is used consistently across all components, making the data model coherent and extensible. The shadcn/ui base layer ensures accessibility patterns (labels, focus rings, ARIA attributes) are inherited automatically.

Closing Reflection

Designed to make you pause

Still is a rare mobile application in that it does not optimise for engagement, session length, or content volume. It optimises for a quality of attention. The design — from the beach metaphor to the literary typography to the 9-second onboarding animation — all serves a single purpose: to help the user arrive, notice, and feel that their observation matters.

“Train your attention on what catches your eye — light, texture, shadow, and the little moments.”

— Still App
